vibe.title: Vibe Check
vibe.content:

• Why today: sunny and mid-50s in the middle of November, the last golden fields before the snow

buzz.title: Daily Buzz
buzz.content:
━━ LOCAL ━━

THE TREE HAS LANDED DOWNTOWN
• Downtown Traverse City's official 2026 Christmas tree arrived Monday, and crews worked from the air and on the ground to stick the landing.
• The tree lighting is Friday at 6:30 PM, and the Light Parade is Saturday night.
➜ TAKE: That tree had a smoother landing than half the flights in America this week.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: real tree or fake tree at your house, and when does it go up?

FAIRY HOUSES BEHIND THE BARNS
• Tucked behind the Botanic Garden at Historic Barns Park, the Fairy Trails let anybody build a tiny fairy house out of sticks, bark and stones, all year long, for free.
• Heather Harrington of Life and Whim Studio started it about ten years ago, and her June fairy house contest draws 50 to 75 builders.
• Natural materials only, so the houses melt back into the woods.
➜ TAKE: Somewhere in Traverse City there's a fairy with better real estate than I have.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: have you ever built a fairy house, and be honest, who REALLY built it, you or the kids?

BEITNER BRIDGE: RIBBON TODAY, CARS LATER
• The Beitner Road bridge that April's flooding washed out gets its ribbon cutting today.
• But don't drive over it yet: the Road Commission says crews still need final touches before it's safe for traffic, and they'll announce the opening date at the ceremony.
➜ TAKE: Seven months of detours, and we're one pair of giant scissors away.
➜ BAIT: Text 231-929-4487: what's your Beitner detour story? How much extra time has it cost you?

━━ BITS ━━

BREAD AND BUTTER DAY
• It's National Homemade Bread Day AND National Butter Day. Thanksgiving is nine days out: is it real butter on the table, or does somebody in your family still put out the margarine tub?

WOULD YOU ROAD TRIP WITH STRANGERS?
• Five strangers stuck at Chicago Midway during the ground stop drove eight hours home to Nashville together. Would you get in the car? And who's the one person you'd NEVER road trip with?

UNDER THE SEA
• The Little Mermaid came out on this day in 1989. What's the Disney song you can still sing every single word of, whether you want to or not?

━━ SPORTS ━━

HUTCHINSON: TORN ACL, OUT FOR THE SEASON
• Follow-up tests confirmed Aidan Hutchinson tore the ACL in his right knee celebrating Sunday's sack in Munich
• The good news: no other major damage, so he can focus on being ready for 2027
• Dan Campbell is expected to talk about it at his press conference today

KINGSLEY HAS A KICKOFF TIME
• Kingsley (12-0) vs. Almont (12-0), Division 6 state semifinal
• Saturday, 1 PM, at Clare High School

ROSCOMMON VOLLEYBALL TONIGHT
• Roscommon vs. Calumet, Division 3 state quarterfinal
• Tonight, 6 PM, at Gaylord High School, and a win sends them to the final four in Battle Creek

mental.title: Mental Health Minute
mental.content:
"Send the Text You Keep Meaning to Send"

We've got a sunny Tuesday and Thanksgiving is nine days away, which means a lot of us are thinking about the people we'll see, and maybe a few we won't. There's probably somebody who popped into your head just now, an old friend, a cousin, a neighbor who moved, and you've been meaning to reach out for months, but you don't, because you figure it'd be weird or they're busy. Here's the thing, though. Researchers who studied this found that people consistently underestimate how much the other person appreciates hearing from them, and the more out of the blue the message, the more it means. So here's your move for today. Before lunch, send one short text to that person, something like, "Saw this and thought of you," or "Hey, I miss our talks, how are you?" You don't need a reason, and you don't need to plan a get-together. The text does the work, and nine times out of ten, you'll get a reply that makes your whole afternoon. That's your Mental Health Minute on Z93. Text me at 231-929-4487 and tell me who you reached out to.
mental.notes: Evidence: Liu, Rim, Min & Min (2022), 'The Surprise of Reaching Out,' Journal of Personality and Social Psychology (people underestimate how much others appreciate being reached out to, more so when the contact is a surprise). Move not used this week (week-used: park the list; catch the sun).

LEANNE MORGAN: THE THERMOSTAT WAR (CARRIED FROM 11/16) · FIRST HALF HOUR: STAND-UP
🎙️ SET UP: Tennessee mom comic Leanne Morgan on hitting your mid-40s: she wants the house at 68 and her husband keeps cranking it to 70. "Who wins the thermostat war at your house?"
🔈 AUDIO SOURCE: Dry Bar Comedy official YouTube. On-air credit: "courtesy of Dry Bar Comedy."
• She sets it to 68, he turns it to 70, and now he's wearing pajamas for the first time in their marriage
🔊 IN: "When you get to be about your mid-40s..." (1:01)
OUT: "...one time he had to wear a toboggan." (1:48)
~47 s · PLAY · READY

⚠️ FLAG: Mild: mentions perimenopause and night sweats (fine for the demo). The cut stops at 1:48, before the beagle bit's crude line.

SNL WEEKEND UPDATE: TOMMY BRENNAN'S FULL THANKSGIVING SONG (EXTRA, CARRIED FROM 11/16) · EXTRA: LATE-NIGHT
🎙️ SET UP: SNL's last show before Thanksgiving, and comic Tommy Brennan sang an "original Thanksgiving song" about the family members who make the holiday. "If you've got THAT relative coming for Thanksgiving, this one's for you."

🎙️ SET UP: When the nationwide ground stop hit, five strangers stuck at Chicago's Midway Airport teamed up and drove eight hours home to Nashville together, and now people are calling them the new Golden Girls. "Inside Edition caught up with the road trip crew. Listen."
🔈 AUDIO SOURCE: Inside Edition official YouTube. On-air credit: "courtesy of Inside Edition."
• Five stranded strangers, one car, ice cream stops and stretch breaks, and an 8-hour ride to Nashville

1️⃣ EARLY SHOW
🧚 Did you know there's a FREE fairy trail tucked behind the Botanic Garden at Historic Barns Park? Anyone can build a tiny fairy house out of sticks, bark and stones, all year long. So be honest: have you ever built one, and who REALLY did the building, you or the kids? 😄 Tell us below or text the studio at 231-929-4487. #Z93 #TraverseCity #UpNorth
📷 MEDIA: the 9&10 News 'Hidden Northern Michigan: Traverse City Fairy Trails' story photo from the article link (credit: 9&10 News)

2️⃣ MID SHOW
🏈💛 KINGSLEY IS 12-0 and two wins from a state title! The Stags take on Almont (also 12-0) in the Division 6 semifinal THIS SATURDAY at 1 PM at Clare High School. Who's making the drive? Drop some love for the Stags! #Z93 #KingsleyStags #UpNorth
📷 MEDIA: a studio snap of AJ in Kingsley colors, or grab one from his prep service

3️⃣ LATE SHOW
🧜‍♀️🎶 On this day in 1989, Disney's The Little Mermaid hit theaters! So here's the real question: what's the Disney song you can STILL sing every single word of? Mine might be 'Under the Sea'... #Z93 #HitsFrom90sToNow
